query:
SELECT 
  id,
  title,
  slug,
  CASE WHEN externalLink IS NULL THEN 'NO_LINK' ELSE 'HAS_LINK' END as link_status,
  CASE WHEN tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(tags) = 0 THEN 'NO_TAGS' ELSE CONCAT(JSON_LENGTH(tags), ' tags') END as tag_status,
  CASE WHEN blocks IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(blocks) = 0 THEN 'NO_BLOCKS' ELSE CONCAT(JSON_LENGTH(blocks), ' blocks') END as block_status,
  CASE WHEN coverImageUrl IS NULL THEN 'NO_IMAGE' ELSE 'HAS_IMAGE' END as image_status
FROM news
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 31;
